tour.title: Project Foundation & Architecture Overview

tour.title: CLI & User Entry Points
tour.description: Explore how users interact with the system via Typer-based CLI commands for live trading, backtesting, and evaluations.

tour.title: Multi-Agent State & Graph Orchestration
tour.description: Dive into the LangGraph state machine orchestrating the analyst debate team (bull, bear, manager) and risk committee.
tour.languageLesson: LangGraph TypedDict state channels allow deterministic message routing and state isolation across autonomous LLM agent debate loops.

tour.title: Analyst Team & Market Research
tour.description: Inspect how fundamental, technical, sentiment, and news analysts produce structured research reports.

tour.title: Investment Debate & Risk Management
tour.description: See how Bull and Bear researchers debate the thesis, moderated by the Research Manager before reaching the Risk Committee.

tour.title: Trader Execution Engine
tour.description: Understand how final portfolio decisions translate into concrete trade proposals, order types, and execution signals.

tour.title: Market Data Connectors & Ingestion
tour.description: Trace how market data, sentiment indices, news, and broker activity are ingested with rate-limiting and caching.
tour.languageLesson: Separating data ingestion adapters into distinct stateless dataflow modules ensures resilience against third-party API rate limits and failures.

tour.title: Backtesting Engine & Margin Simulation
tour.description: Examine how the historical simulation engine enforces strict lookahead-bias prevention, position sizing, and margin accounting.
tour.languageLesson: Enforcing strict temporal cutoffs with dedicated validation classes prevents lookahead data leakage in AI financial simulations.
